content.text: 长度和质量记录：我只量了木条长度，读数是 12 厘米；我明确没有称木条的质量。

cases.text: 上次长度和质量记录里，我测了什么，没测什么？

review.expected: Length was measured as 12 cm; mass was explicitly not weighed. Preserve the explicit negative rather than replacing it with unknown, and keep quantity/unit roles distinct.
failures: Claiming mass was weighed or inventing a mass value.
Turning the explicit no-weighing report into unknown merely because other cases have missing evidence.
Confusing length with mass, centimetres with grams, or a suggested next measurement with an earlier result.

cases.text: 上次斜坡计时的两次实际时长相同吗？接受的下次计划当时执行了吗？

review.expected: The two actual durations were different: 6 and 9 seconds. The accepted future 10-second plan was explicitly not performed in the recorded activity; do not backfill it into either earlier trial.

Turning acceptance of the plan into execution or mastery.
Moving the historical unexecuted plan into a current completed result.
